title: Core Speed Discrepancy & Fuel Flow to Ps30 Ratio Imbalance

telemetry_indicators.sensor_9: Physical core speed exhibits abnormal oscillation or exceeds 9065 rpm
telemetry_indicators.sensor_12: Ratio of fuel flow to Ps30 drops or deviates > 3% from scheduled curve
telemetry_indicators.sensor_14: Corrected core speed shows non-linear divergence

root_causes: Fuel metering unit (FMU) servo valve stiction or contamination
Combustor fuel nozzle spray tip carbon coking causing asymmetric spray pattern
Hydro-mechanical unit pressure differential transducer drift
dispatch_protocol: Requires FADEC fault log dump and fuel nozzle functional bench test before next dispatch.
inspection_procedure: Step 1: Download non-volatile memory (NVM) diagnostic faults from Engine Electronic Controller (EEC/FADEC).
Step 2: Remove fuel nozzles 1 through 18 and inspect for carbon deposit buildup and flow asymmetry.
Step 3: Measure fuel manifold delta-P during dry crank cycle.
Step 4: Conduct high-pressure filter differential pressure switch verification.
safety_advisories: Depressurize aircraft fuel feed manifold to 0 psi before loosening B-nut fittings. Ground static bonding clip required.
